p8_b1.ocr: In the third quarter of 2023, Booking Holdings reported a theme park attendance growth of 15.2%, alongside an average spend per visitor of $85.60, contributing to a customer satisfaction rate of 92.5%. The financial metrics indicate a price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of 25.4, a current ratio of 1.8, and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.6, reflecting a solid financial position. The gross margin stands at 45.3%, while the net profit margin is recorded at 12.8%.

p8_b2.ocr: In terms of operating income, the company achieved $40M, which is indicative of efficient operations and cost management. Total revenue reached $320M, with total expenses at $280M, showcasing a robust financial performance in the hospitality and tourism sector. These metrics collectively highlight the successful operational strategies and financial health of Booking Holdings within the Asia-Pacific region during this period, emphasizing a positive trajectory in attendance and revenue generation while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
